derivability.assertion: test_storage_file_layout (mcap/sqlite3): file named <dir>/<dir>.mcap|.db3, only storage file + metadata.yaml present, storage_identifier and relative_file_paths
test_header_record: profile ros2, library rosbags-<version>
test_data_section_shape: only Chunk/MessageIndex/Metadata/DataEnd outside chunks, one Metadata, message indexes follow chunk, DataEnd last, CRC zero-or-correct

test_footer_and_summary_offsets: footer offsets, summary grouped in order schema/channel/chunkindex/metadataindex/statistics, one summary offset per group with exact start/length, summary CRC zero-or-correct
test_schema_records: ids from 1 in add_msgtype order, name/encoding/data, dedup of shared msgtype, summary copies equal data-section copies
test_channel_records: id, schema_id by msgtype, topic, message_encoding, metadata {offered_qos_profiles: verbatim string}, schema precedes channel
test_message_records_in_write_order: channel_id, log_time==publish_time==timestamp, sequence 0, data bytes
test_chunk_records_and_chunk_indexes: compression per mode, sizes, start/end times, chunk_start_offset/chunk_length, message_index_offsets/length cover the following message index records
test_message_index_records: one per channel with messages, ordered by first message, entries point at message records in the uncompressed buffer, every message indexed once
test_statistics_record: counts, attachment 0, metadata 1, start/end, channel_message_counts incl. zero channels, channels before statistics
test_metadata_record_and_index: one Metadata 'rosbag2' {serialized_metadata: yaml == metadata.yaml info}, Metadata Index offset/length/name
test_mcap_python_seeking_reader / streaming_reader_validates_crcs: mcap-python reads messages (time order, topic filter, time window), CRCs validate
test_rosbags_reader_roundtrip (mcap): Reader(dir), Reader(file), McapReader.chunks and statistics, connection ext/msgdef
test_writer_compression_modes (file/message) for both plugins
test_chunking_threshold: chunk partition computed from record sizes and the >1 MiB rule; per-chunk channel sets, time ranges, compression ratio
test_empty_bag: no chunks, Metadata + DataEnd, summary = MetadataIndex + Statistics, zero counts, sentinel times, readable

test_schema_only_chunk_direct_storage_api: direct McapWriter use, chunk with schema+channel only, no message index, empty message_index_offsets, sentinel times, channel_message_counts {1: 0}, QoS string verbatim
test_fixture_rewritten_as_mcap_matches_mcap_fixture, test_rosbag2_recorded_mcap_fixture_roundtrip: message sets, topic->schema map, deserialized fields equal to rosbag2 fixtures
test_convert_cli_writes_mcap / writes_sqlite3
test_mcap_cli_doctor_accepts_file (7 files incl. empty, schema-only, multichunk, fixture rewrites): mcap doctor exit 0, mcap info profile ros2
test_schema_matches_rosbag2_recorded_bag: table_info of 5 tables equals ROS 2 rolling recorded v4 bag, index timestamp_idx ASC, no other user tables
test_schema_table_row: (4, 'rosbags')
test_metadata_table_row: one row id 1, metadata_version == version, YAML equals metadata.yaml info
